description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss Ratio (%) and TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a non-linear scale with specific tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8, representing a range from 1e7 to 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, which remains entirely steady at a value of 100 across the entire x-axis from 1e7 to 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64)" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with plus markers; it starts at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and ends at approximately 100 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=128)" configuration is depicted by a solid dark blue line with cross markers, beginning at roughly 97.0 at 1e7, rising to approximately 99.8 at 2e8, and remaining relatively stable to end at roughly 99.7 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" configuration is represented by a solid green line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 97.5 at 1e7, rising to a peak of roughly 100.2 at 6e8, and concluding at approximately 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configuration is shown as a solid red line with circle markers, starting at the lowest point of approximately 94.0 at 1e7, rising steeply to roughly 99.1 at 4e8, experiencing a dip to approximately 98.4 at 5e8, and ending at roughly 98.7 at 9e8.
